title: 2025-00176 — Procedural Order - Responses Concerning Reconciliation Overview and Exeter Benefits Analysis_.pdf
text:
STATE OF MAINE 
PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION 

Docket No. 2025-00176 

July 10, 2026 
PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION 
Investigation of Time of Use Rates for 
Delivery and Standard Offer Service for 
Investor-Owned Transmission and 
Distribution Utilities 

PROCEDURAL ORDER Staff 
Responses Concerning 
Reconciliation Overview and 
Exeter Response Concerning 
Benefits Analysis 

In a May 29, 2026 procedural order, Commission Staff filed a description of the 
approach the Commission’s consultant Exeter Associates will take in estimating the 
benefits of the straw proposals. See, Attachment 1 to Procedural Order Regarding 
Synapse Straw Proposals; Benefit Calculations; Further Process, May 29, 2026, 
Attachment 1. Parties were invited to file questions or comments on this document. On 
June 17, 2026 Versant Power (Versant) filed comments. One June 18, 2026, comments 
were filed by the Office of the Public Advocate (OPA), Central Maine Power Company 
(CMP), Efficiency Maine Trust, and AARP Maine. Attachment 1 to this procedural order 
contains Exeter’s responses to these comments. 

On June 9, 2026, Staff filed its overview of the reconciliation process in 
connection Straw Proposal # 1. See Attachment 2 to June 9, 2026 Procedural Order – 
Remaining Iterative Process on Costs and Benefits Estimates. In this order, parties 
were provided an opportunity to file responsive comments and questions. On June 25, 
the OPA, CMP, and Versant each filed comments on this overview. Attachment 2 to this 
procedural order contains Staff responses to the questions raised in these comments. 

Dated at Hallowell, Maine, this 10th day of July 2026. 

BY ORDER OF THE PRESIDING OFFICERS 

/s/ Eric Bryant 
Eric J. Bryant 

/s/ Leslie Raber 
Leslie Raber
case_title: COMMISSION INITIATED INVESTIGATION OF TIME OF USE RATES FOR DELIVERY AND STANDARD OFFER SERVICE FOR INVESTOR-OWNED TRANSMISSION AND DISTRIBUTION UTILITIES
